caption: The drawing shows a circular arrangement of flowers and leaves set against a textured, dark brown background. The composition includes several large red and light pink flowers with layered petals, interspersed with a few light blue trumpet-shaped flowers and cream-colored bell-shaped flowers. The flowers are surrounded by multiple green leaves, some detailed with lighter or darker shading. The leaves and flowers are arranged to form a loose wreath or ring pattern, with the green foliage radiating outward and curving around the circle. The background is primarily dark brown with areas of lighter brown and black, creating a mottled, almost shadowed effect around the central floral motif. The overall color palette of the drawing includes reds, pinks, greens, blues, creams, and various shades of brown.
title: Hooked Rug
